name: Tacho
description:
Gauges in the top bar: CPU and temperature, memory, network, your Claude Code and Codex limits, Docker containers and the Kubernetes context (red when it points at production).

Three layouts: one combined item with graphs, separate items with graphs, or separate items without. Everything is read locally from /proc, /sys, the assistants' session logs, the Docker socket and ~/.kube/config. Nothing is sent anywhere.
